treatments.name: Lifestyle interventions and self-management
treatments.population: Adults with diabetes and chronic kidney disease
treatments.summary: Lifestyle interventions and self-management form the foundation of a layered approach to care.

evidence.quote: starting with a foundation of lifestyle interventions, self-management, and first-line pharmacotherapy
evidence.statement: Care is built on a foundation of lifestyle interventions and self-management.

treatments.name: SGLT-2 inhibitors
treatments.population: Adults with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease
treatments.summary: Named as first-line pharmacotherapy in diabetes with CKD because of demonstrated clinical outcome benefits.

evidence.quote: A focus on preserving kidney function and maintaining well-being is recommended using a layered approach to care, starting with a foundation of lifestyle interventions, self-management, and first-line pharmacotherapy (such as sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors) demonstrated to improve clinical outcomes.
evidence.statement: SGLT-2 inhibitors are first-line pharmacotherapy in the layered approach for diabetes and CKD.

milestones.label: KDIGO 2022 update positions SGLT-2 inhibitors as first-line in diabetes with CKD
milestones.quote: The KDIGO 2022 Clinical Practice Guideline for Diabetes Management in Chronic Kidney Disease is an update of the 2020 guideline from Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO).

treatments.name: GLP-1 receptor agonists
treatments.population: Adults with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease
treatments.summary: Added on top of first-line therapy for additional heart and kidney protection.

evidence.quote: To this are added additional drugs with heart and kidney protection, such as glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists and nonsteroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists
evidence.statement: GLP-1 receptor agonists are layered on top of first-line therapy for heart and kidney protection.

treatments.name: Nonsteroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists
treatments.population: Adults with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease
treatments.summary: Added on top of first-line therapy for additional heart and kidney protection.

evidence.quote: To this are added additional drugs with heart and kidney protection, such as glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists and nonsteroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists
evidence.statement: Nonsteroidal MRAs are layered on top of first-line therapy for heart and kidney protection.

treatments.name: Blood pressure, glycemia and lipid control
treatments.population: Adults with diabetes and chronic kidney disease
treatments.summary: Risk-factor control for CKD progression and cardiovascular events is added to the layered approach.

evidence.quote: interventions to control risk factors for CKD progression and cardiovascular events, such as blood pressure, glycemia, and lipids
evidence.statement: Blood pressure, glucose and lipid control are part of comprehensive care.

notes: Applies to adults with diabetes and chronic kidney disease.
